title: Jesus... I Fell Asleep In The Office Washroom 😮‍💨
topic: exhausted after a third late night, he fell asleep in the office washroom and told his manager he was on a call

bible.text: He gives power to the faint and increases the strength of the weak.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... I fell asleep in the office washroom for ten minutes. I told my manager I was on a call. 😮‍💨

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Third late night this week. I answer emails at 1 a.m. and still say I'm good.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You're not good. You're running on other people's approval.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: If I slow down, someone else takes my place.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Your place with Me was never earned by overtime. Even I stepped away to rest.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Going home on time isn't quitting. It's trusting.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Send this to the coworker who's always online. 💻
